purpose: Trigger-boundary regression set for ugt-help. S* queries must route to ugt-help; N* queries must NOT — each N names the correct destination instead. The risky neighbours are ugt-nextjs-full-setup ('ต้องเตรียมอะไรบ้าง'), mattpocock-skills:ask-matt (another router), Claude Code's built-in /help, and the word 'help' meaning ordinary help.
method: 3 independent judges, randomized order, query ids blinded, full skill listing incl. superpowers + mattpocock + frontend-design distractors

baseline_result.method_note: Judges ran as 3 sonnet subagents, each with its own shuffled order and blinded ids (Q1..Q20), given the skill listing as TEXT generated from the repo SKILL.md frontmatter (19 ugt skills incl. ugt-help) plus distractors from the installed superpowers 7.0.2, mattpocock-skills 1.3.1 (engineering/) and frontend-design caches — 55 entries. Instructed to answer only from the listing.
baseline_result.note: S-side 30/30; no N query was pulled into ugt-help — the full-setup overlap ('ต้องเตรียมอะไรบ้างก่อนขึ้น server'), the other router (ask-matt), Claude Code's /help, 'help me fix' and 'หน้า help ในแอป' all stayed out. Secondary misses touch no ugt skill: N8 → mattpocock-skills:wayfinder 2/3 (a fair reading of 'plan a huge chunk of work', now accepted) · N9 → none 3/3 instead of brainstorming/frontend-design (judges answer an app-feature request without a skill).
